message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the case.

Facts: In Zhejiang Ningbo, defendant Xu (no construction qualification) contracted a packaging company's pipeline exhaust building renovation. During construction, he as contractor neglected high-altitude safety measures, didn't ensure workers wore safety gear, no safety education/training. Worker Wang fell from about 7 meters, died. Investigation says Xu directly responsible. He voluntarily surrendered, confessed. Civil compensation settled.

This is a production safety accident caused by negligence. The list includes "重大责任事故" (major responsibility accident) and "玩忽职守" (dereliction of duty) and "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide). Also "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" (negligent dangerous method endangering public safety). The examples: earlier similar case with mine accident was labeled "重大责任事故". Another case with forklift accident causing death was also "重大责任事故". So likely "重大责任事故". Also could be "玩忽职守". But the list includes "玩忽职守" as a charge. In many Chinese criminal law, causing a major accident due to negligence can be charged under "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident). The fact says "对事故发生负有直接责任". So the appropriate charge is "重大责任事故". Also maybe "过失致人死亡". But the list includes that as separate. In examples, the forklift case was "重大责任事故". So we follow that.

Thus answer: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>
